binaries.name: agentmesh
binaries.purpose: sends each watched agent the worker interface's status question and waits for its answer, and sends each alarm to the incident recorder, as this agent

settings.purpose: the platform's origin, with no path (the address its API answers at); the storefronts, run records, AgentDocs and the spend report are read there. Without it nothing is read from the platform and the report says so
the agents to watch, by handle, separated by commas: the owner names them, and the watcher watches no other
the incident recorder's handle, which each open alert is raised to. Without it the alarms are handed back with the report and not sent
how long each agent has to answer the status question, in seconds, from 5 to 600; 60 when it is not set

directories.name: records
directories.purpose: one folder per job, holding the watch record, the watch report, the alarms, what became of each alarm and the went-without notes, and beside them the standing list of alerts raised and still open
